'''Haruka Shamoto''' (Japanese: '''社本悠''' ''Shamoto Haruka'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Shamoto was born on Nov 12 in Aichi Prefecture, Japan and became an actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she voiced one of [[Chloe]]'s classmates. Later on in the series, Shamoto began to voice additional characters and Pokémon. She returned in {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing a [[Pokémon Center lady]].
